claim.purpose: Prepare AI agent podcast weekly launch readiness docs without publishing live hosting

initial.title: [v0.91.8][podcast][planning] Revive AI agent podcast weekly cadence
initial.goal: Revive the earlier AI agent podcast work into a weekly launch-readiness plan for the week of July 27, 2026.
initial.required_outcome: Tracked v0.91.8 planning docs identify old podcast evidence, the `agent-logic.ai/podcast` launch requirements, studio workflow, first ten topics, and non-claims before future implementation.
authority_boundary: Issue #5605 owns planning and launch-readiness docs only
No website deployment, RSS publication, audio rendering, guest outreach, or live cadence claim in this issue
initial.task_boundary: Create and validate podcast revival planning artifacts for future launch execution.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: old v0.91.1/v0.91.3 podcast artifacts are inventoried as historical evidence, not live proof
AC-2: `agent-logic.ai/podcast` route, page, archive, feed, studio, and launch gates are specified
AC-3: first ten weekly topics are documented with a non-geeky audience posture and week-two DeepSeek invitation option
AC-4: v0.91.8 feature, review, demo, and proof indexes link the new planning surfaces
AC-5: validation proves referenced paths exist, stale host paths/secrets are absent, old packet demo still passes, and bounded review is clean
dependencies: Historical podcast demos and packets from v0.91.1 and v0.91.3
Future agent-logic.ai website execution issue for live route deployment
non_goals: No guest outreach or representation that a guest has accepted
initial.plan_summary: Inventory prior podcast evidence, author launch-readiness and topic-planning docs, update v0.91.8 indexes, validate, review, and publish.

steps.action: Inventory old podcast evidence and current non-claims
Author launch-readiness, hosting, studio workflow, and topic-slate docs
Link v0.91.8 indexes and record proof boundaries
Run focused validation, bounded review, publish, and close out truthfully

risks: Overclaiming a live public podcast before the website route and feed exist
Treating historical demo packets as current production proof
invariants: No secrets, absolute host paths, or provider credentials in planning artifacts
Future launch gates remain explicit and fail closed
stop_conditions: Any request to publish live web/audio/RSS surfaces inside #5605
Any need for provider credentials, AWS, or external guest outreach
review_prompts: Do the docs avoid claiming the podcast is already live or operating weekly?
Are the prior podcast artifacts linked as historical evidence with truthful proof boundaries?
Are launch gates and future implementation requirements complete enough for next-week execution?
operator_constraints: Planning only; no publication/live hosting claim
initial.review_scope: Podcast planning docs and v0.91.8 index updates for #5605

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove all launch-readiness references point to tracked repo surfaces
Prove the existing v0.91.3 podcast packet generator still works
Prove the existing v0.91.3 podcast packet contract remains deterministic
Prove docs contain no secrets or host paths and pass whitespace diff checks

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed if any referenced evidence path is missing, any artifact overclaims live publication, or bounded review finds actionable issues.
